## Description

Schedule child orders against an estimated intraday volume curve to target volume-weighted average price.

## Where it may fit

Liquid instruments with predictable intraday volume patterns and adequate order participation limits.

## Vehicles

Stocks, ETFs and futures; institutional execution.

## Required data

Parent order, historical intraday volume curve, live volume, price/quotes, session calendar, order status and participation cap.

## Caveats

Volume-curve forecast error and market impact matter; a VWAP benchmark is not a guarantee of best execution.
